headline: Lahore was ranked the world's most polluted major city on Monday with an IQAir Air Quality Index of 590, while the Allama Iqbal Town station recorded 1,033.

card.desc: Monday subah AQI 590, Allama Iqbal Town mein 1,033 tak pohncha.

caption:
Lahore ki hawa phir dunya mein sab se kharab, AQI 590!
Dawn ke mutabiq Monday ko IQAir ki ranking mein Lahore dunya ka sab se zyada pollution wala bara shehar raha. Yahan AQI 590 tha, jo doosre number ke shehar se 3 guna se bhi zyada hai. Allama Iqbal Town mein AQI 1,033 tak pohnch gaya. Report ke mutabiq 9 aur 10 November ko pollution zyada rahegi, aur 11 November se thori behtari ki umeed hai.
Aap smog se bachne ke liye kya karte hain? Comment mein batayein 👇
